paragraphs.text: Two witnesses stand up against the silence. First, what your teacher told you. Second, what the scriptures fittingly promise. Together they are strong enough to wipe out a whole pile of clever arguments. And once the cloud of doubt melts away, all that is left is this: touching the feet of the Lord whose splendor blazes in the sky of your heart, bright as the sun that beats the dark.
